# `/personal-access-tokens` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /personal-access-tokens/v1

`listPersonalAccessTokensV1` — List personal access tokens

This gets a collection of personal access tokens associated with the optional `owner-id`. query parameter. If the `owner-id` query parameter is omitted, all personal access tokens for a tenant will be retrieved, but the caller must have the 'idn:all-personal-access-tokens:read' right.

- Scopes: sp:all-personal-access-tokens:manage, sp:all-personal-access-tokens:read, sp:my-personal-access-tokens:manage, sp:my-personal-access-tokens:read
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `owner-id` (query) — default None — The identity ID of the owner whose personal access tokens should be listed. If "me", the caller should have the following right: 'idn:my-personal-access-tokens:read' If an actual owner ID or if the…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: lastUsed: le, isnull — e.g. `lastUsed le 2023-02-05T10:59:27.214Z`
- Returns 200: array of getpersonalaccesstokenresponse

### POST /personal-access-tokens/v1

`createPersonalAccessTokenV1` — Create personal access token

This creates a personal access token. **expirationDate and userAwareTokenNeverExpires Relationship:** **Important:** When `expirationDate` is `null` or empty (not included in the request body), the token will never expire. **Required Validation:** If `expirationDate` is `null` or empty, `userAwareTokenNeverExpires` must be set to `true`. This is a required validation rule. The valid values for `expirationDate` depend on the value provided for `userAwareTokenNeverExpires`: * **When…

- Scopes: sp:all-personal-access-tokens:manage, sp:my-personal-access-tokens:manage
- User levels: Any
- Body (application/json): createpersonalaccesstokenrequest
- Returns 200: createpersonalaccesstokenresponse

### PATCH /personal-access-tokens/v1/{id}

`patchPersonalAccessTokenV1` — Patch personal access token

This performs a targeted update to the field(s) of a Personal Access Token. Changing scopes for a Personal Access Token does not impact existing bearer tokens. You will need to create a new bearer token to have the new scopes. Please note that it can take up to 20 minutes for scope changes to be seen on new bearer tokens. **expirationDate and userAwareTokenNeverExpires Relationship:** **Important:** When `expirationDate` is `null` or empty (replaced to `null` or omitted from the patch…

- Scopes: sp:my-personal-access-tokens:manage
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The Personal Access Token id
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: getpersonalaccesstokenresponse

### DELETE /personal-access-tokens/v1/{id}

`deletePersonalAccessTokenV1` — Delete personal access token

This deletes a personal access token.

- Scopes: sp:all-personal-access-tokens:manage, sp:my-personal-access-tokens:manage
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The personal access token id
- Returns 204: no body

### PATCH /personal-access-tokens/v1/bulk-update

`updateBulkPersonalAccessTokensV1` — Bulk update personal access tokens

This applies a single [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) document to multiple personal access tokens (PATs) in the current tenant in one request. The same `patch` is applied to every token referenced in `ids`. Up to **25** tokens can be updated per request. This is an administrative operation intended for org admins managing PATs across their tenant. The caller must have the `idn:all-personal-access-tokens:update` right. API OAuth client credentials are not permitted to call…

- Scopes: sp:all-personal-access-tokens:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): bulkupdatepersonalaccesstokensrequest
- Returns 200: array of getpersonalaccesstokenresponse
